integrity: Analytic proof with separately reproducible finite-section numerical checks. No independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Only a large-parameter asymptotic for negative-weight Dirichlet spaces; does not solve the exact-radius problem at fixed general exponent. Some older Jacobi spectral literature may contain equivalent expansions.
title: Sharp multi-exponential radius asymptotics and finite-degree localization for negative Dirichlet optimal approximants
